text: Independent verification: these events were fetched live from public relays — damus and nos.lol — not from LNbits.
Every listing is a valid NIP-99 event, signed by the merchant key and retrievable by any Nostr client.
And the buyer's order message — gift-wrapped end to end, decryptable only by the customer's key.
Infinite Markets — one authoritative inventory, Lightning checkout, Nostr-native distribution.
